claim: The renderer's GetFont(family, size, bold) (vtable 0x140cc30 slot 0x220 -> 0x116cbb0) rounds the size down to even, clamps it to 6..32 and opens font/<family>_[b_]<n>.cuf, so the list name Frontend 38 opens frontend_32.cuf and no size above 32 is ever opened by it
